summary: fractal-web app shell: read-only agent sidebar, data layer and st3 SDK; gateway JSON streams negotiated Brotli/gzip representations with Accept-Encoding variation. Sidebar rows never show an unknown raw status value; it reads as Not observed, including in hover cards, and navigating dismisses only the active sidebar hover card without replacing roster rows

replay.detail: Read-only shell and data projections; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol or deployed runtime compatibility change. View preferences (collapsed folders, pane layout, devbar visibility, usage unit) persist in localStorage; they hold no content or names, unknown IDs are ignored, and invalid values fall back to defaults.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the app is not deployed by this change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
